name: Talismans
look: Talisman barrier from cultivation fantasy. Six yellow paper talismans painted with red glyphs orbit the character, joined to each other by thin lines of golden light forming a hexagon.
subject: shield

rows.name: INIT
rows.caption: shield forms
rows.text: the talismans flick out one by one from the character's hand and take their places in the ring, the light lines joining them

rows.name: IDLE
rows.caption: shield holds
rows.text: the talismans orbit slowly and flutter, the light lines between them glowing; it loops

rows.name: HIT
rows.caption: blow lands from the right
rows.text: a blow strikes from the right; the talisman on that side flares and burns up in a puff of fire, the light lines flicker but hold

rows.name: BREAK
rows.caption: shield ends
rows.text: the remaining talismans catch fire one after another and burn to drifting ash
